name: Joining Metals
old_description: Empower your business by entrusting us with the production of your steel parts. Our advanced facilities and skilled team guarantee top-quality components, while our streamlined processes enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
about:
Joining Metals operates a 30,000-square-foot facility in Perry, Ohio, in the northeastern part of the state. The family-owned small business was established in 2002 and has since focused on sheet metal fabrication and assembly for a range of industrial and commercial clients.

The shop provides laser cutting, forming, welding, and assembly, taking jobs from low-volume prototypes through high-volume production runs. Annual output exceeds one million parts, with the company reporting a 99.9 percent on-time delivery rate across its customer base of more than 150 accounts.

Customers span logistics and material handling, conveyor systems, industrial filtration equipment, cylinder manufacturing, hospitality and retail fixtures, personal and medical mobility devices, and aftermarket performance automotive components.

The company emphasizes five core values — safety, integrity, teamwork, quality, and service — and states its mission is to foster long-lasting relationships by delivering cost-effective manufacturing solutions with speed and precision that exceed expectations.
